Decipher.com Premiere card image for [[Black 3]] (Wayback). It has the black border of Premiere Limited but prints the game text of [[Black 3 (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] (April 1996), which added “Must have pilot aboard to use power or maneuver.”; the printed Limited face is [[:File:Premiere-D-black3-hires.webp]].

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020804005247/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/images/black3.gif Decipher.com card image] (Wayback copy of decipher.com/starwars/cardlists).

Do not replace the Holotable/remaster face [[File:Premiere-D-black3.gif]].
